verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Copilot can run code for calculations and generate graphs, and 'Analyst' turns raw data into insights, supporting the core of the story. However, there is no explicit documentation of producing downloadable output files, and community feedback shows some Office-integrated Copilot features (Word/Excel/Outlook) underperform in practice, raising doubts about reliability of this capability in production use. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of downloadable file output, independent hands-on verification of chart/code generation working reliably.
